stemMd: Which recommendation most closely follows the researchers’ caution?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Use only tests identical to the training task to establish broad transfer.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Ignore feedback because the passage proves it irrelevant.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Require every learner to use retrieval because no exceptions exist.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Test whether prior familiarity changes the average benefit before prescribing one strategy universally.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Infer each participant’s score directly from the group mean.

explanationMd: The recommendation investigates a proposed moderator and avoids universal claims not supported by the group-level result.

distractorRationale.e: Group means do not describe each person.
distractorRationale.a: Such tests leave the format-specific explanation unresolved.
distractorRationale.c: The study does not establish a universal individual benefit.
distractorRationale.b: Feedback use is proposed as a possible moderator.
